fields.description: Number of trailing calendar months of Sales Invoice history used to compute median monthly demand.
fields.label: Trailing Months

fields.description: Fallback lead time (in months) used when an Item's Lead Time Days is not set.
fields.label: Default Lead Time (Months)

fields.description: Minimum usable months of sales history (after stockout-month exclusion) required to compute a reorder level. Items below this go to manual review.
fields.label: Minimum History (Months)

fields.description: A trailing month exceeding this multiple of the item's raw median is clipped and flagged as an anomaly.
fields.label: Anomaly Multiplier

fields.description: Suggested order quantity exceeding this many months of median demand is flagged as a large order (not blocked).
fields.label: Max Suggested Months

fields.description: Per-item deviation (%) between Sales Invoice qty and Stock Ledger outgoing qty above which the corroboration flag is set.
fields.label: Corroboration Threshold (%)

fields.description: Warehouses whose stock counts toward current/projected qty. Transit/supplier warehouses (e.g. an overseas holding warehouse) should not be included here.
fields.label: Included Warehouses

fields.description: Role notified when an item newly crosses into Critical / Reorder Now status.
fields.label: Notify Role
